prompt: Elegant modern Italian trattoria instrumental for a high-end wood-fired pizzeria. Warm fingerstyle acoustic guitar and mandolin lead melody over soft string quartet pads, gentle accordion swells, candlelit supperclub atmosphere. Subtle Indian fusion accents: distant sitar flourishes, soft tabla pulses, a low tanpura drone under the harmonies. Cinematic, refined, unhurried, romantic, 70 BPM. No vocals, no drums-heavy sections.

songs.title: Tavolo Di Luna
songs.tags: Cinematic Italian folk fusion at 70 BPM with an unhurried brushed feel; verse bed in warm fingerstyle acoustic guitar and mandolin, chorus-like lifts from soft string quartet pads and gentle accordion swells, while subtle Indian accents add distant sitar flourishes, soft tabla pulses, and a low tanpura drone. Sections evolve from intimate guitar-and-drone opening to fuller strings, then a restrained centerpiece with mandolin lead. Airy legato, occasional reverse swells, and delicate room-reverb chimes. Wide, refined, candlelit, high-end supperclub mix., fingerstyle, gentle, drone, warm, refined, accordion, acoustic, soft, string quartet, romantic, low
